subject: Implementation surcharge & SLA packaging for Medscope VPC deployment
messages:
From: Sara Hollis <sara.hollis@medscope.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T15:23:00Z
Subject: Private VPC pricing — implementation fees and SLA options

Thanks Hannah and Marissa — great kickoff today. Attached is our RFP and a short summary of our deployment targets (on-prem controllers + 4 GPU nodes in our colocation). Two quick asks so we can move the procurement review along: 1) an itemized implementation/installation fee (we prefer a single one-time charge but are open to amortization options for CAPEX accounting), and 2) concrete SLA/support tiers with costs (we need an enterprise-grade on-call option).

We expect to go to legal/procurement next week; any accelerators on pricing or packaging would be helpful. Procurement contact is procurement@medscope.ai (cc'd on later messages).

Sara Hollis
Head of Cloud Platform
Medscope Health
[Attachment: RFP_Medscope_2026.pdf — 250KB]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hollis <sara.hollis@medscope.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:11:00Z
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing — implementation fees and SLA options

Hi Sara — thanks for the RFP and the context. High level reply while Marissa and I model the numbers:

- Platform licensing: annual platform fee (covers control plane, update channel, model catalog access) + per-node runtime units. Typical starting point for a footprint like yours is a $160k platform fee + node units.
- Implementation: we usually quote a one-time implementation/installation fee to cover on-site validation, orchestration integration, and customer acceptance testing. For your footprint that tends to land in the $35k–$60k range depending on scope.
- Amortization: we can amortize the implementation fee across 36 months for accounting purposes (you'd still pay as OPEX via monthly invoicing).
- Support tiers: Bronze (business hours), Silver (24x5), Gold (24x7 + named on-call + quarterly architecture reviews). I attached a draft SLA matrix for reference.

I'm attaching SOW_Draft_v3 with assumptions and an SLA matrix. Suggest a 30-minute procurement run-through Tuesday to lock scope/acceptance criteria.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_Draft_v3.pdf — stub]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T14:02:00Z
Subject: internal: pricing levers for Medscope (deal HS-59321)

Hannah / Vanessa — internal note on concessions we can consider if Medscope will commit to a 3-year term and a 30% node utilization minimum: 

- Implementation surcharge: offer a 20% one-time discount on the implementation fee (cap at $12k) if they sign a 36-month term.
- Platform fee: 10% reduction in year one, with standard list in years 2–3.
- Support: include one complimentary migration week of Gold-tier engineering hours (up to 40 hrs) as an activation credit instead of reducing price.
- Payment: allow CAPEX amortization support (we invoice 36 monthly installments) but require upfront acceptance of the SOW.

If procurement pushes back on the upfront invoice, consider splitting the implementation fee: 50% at kickoff, 50% net-30 after acceptance. I left a note in HubSpot (HS-59321) with the margin impact.

Marissa
Sr. Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Hollis <sara.hollis@medscope.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medscope.ai
Date: 2026-12-18T20:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing — implementation fees and SLA options

Thanks Hannah and Marissa. A few follow-ups from procurement: 

- The one-time implementation fee is the primary blocker for our CFO — they prefer capitalization and a fixed monthly amortization over 36 months that hits our CAPEX schedule. Can Redwood provide an invoice schedule that supports capex treatment (i.e., monthly invoices tied to milestones)?
- The 10% year-one platform reduction helps, but CFO is asking whether we can trade some of the implementation fee for deeper recurring discount (e.g., lower platform fees over the full 36 months instead of a single-year concession).
- Also need a clearer definition of acceptance criteria for the migration (we require a signed checklist tied to final payment).

I'm attaching the procurement POC contact details. If we can present a mutually acceptable amortization and acceptance plan, we can expedite to legal next week.

Sara
[Attachment: Medscope_Procurement_POC.vcf — contact card]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hollis <sara.hollis@medscope.ai>, procurement@medscope.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:05:00Z
Subject: Proposal: amortized implementation + blended platform discount (final pricing proposal)

Sara / procurement team — appreciate the clarity. Based on your ask and internal approvals, here's a concrete proposal for legal review and procurement sign-off: 

1) Implementation fee
- Total one-time amount: $48,000 (covers onsite validation, orchestration integration, and acceptance testing).
- Invoice schedule to support capitalization: billable in 36 equal monthly installments of $1,333 labeled as "implementation amortization" and tied to milestone acceptance. First installment invoiced within 30 days of SOW signature.
- Acceptance: we will include a migration acceptance checklist (deliverable list inside SOW_Draft_v3) that gates the final acceptance milestone.

2) Platform licensing
- Blended approach: reduce platform fee by 15% each year for the first 12 months and then 7% year-over-year for years 2–3 (effective blended discount to address your CFO's request for recurring savings).
- Continue per-node runtime billing as outlined in the SOW.

3) Support and credits
- Provide one complimentary migration week of Gold-tier engineering (up to 40 hrs) as an activation credit.
- Optional: add named on-call and accelerated SLA (Gold) for an additional monthly retainer.

4) Commercial anchors
- Term: 36 months; minimum node commitment: 4 nodes.
- If Medscope increases committed nodes in-year, we will re-evaluate credits/discounts pro-rata.

Next steps
- If this is acceptable, please countersign the attached SOW_Draft_v3 and we will generate a DocuSign envelope for procurement. I've also attached SLA_Tiers.xlsx showing the SLOs by tier.

If procurement wants to see the margin impact before countersign, I can share a redacted P&L impact. Otherwise, I can stand up a short call Friday to close.

Best — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: SOW_Draft_v3.pdf, SLA_Tiers.xlsx]
